brief.subject: Vibe Coding for Beginners
brief.goal: Opening motion graphic before S01: set the tone of the lecture in 15 seconds
brief.message: Say what you want, and it becomes working code

visualStyle.medium: Chalk-on-blueprint SVG line drawing: strokes draw themselves, static grain erodes every line
visualStyle.lighting: Deep navy board (canvas-deep) with cream chalk (paper) and a single amber accent (primary)
visualStyle.typography: Script (Great Vibes) for the human voice, mono (JetBrains Mono) for code, display serif (Playfair Display) for the title
visualStyle.density: One idea per shot, generous negative space
visualStyle.cameraFeeling: Slow push-in inside each shot; zoom-through cuts dive into a focal detail

beats.visual: Amber spark ignites, a speech bubble draws itself, the prompt is handwritten in script on calligraphy guides, an amber send button is pressed
beats.notes: Human words first: the whole idea starts from a sentence. Zoom dives into the send button.

beats.visual: Curly braces frame code that types itself fast with an amber caret; a syntax tree grows on the right, linked by an amber dashed line
beats.notes: The sentence becomes code at machine speed. Dive into the while node.

beats.visual: Rulers, an app window wireframe with hatched hero, text lines, amber button and cards draw in sequence
beats.notes: Code becomes a designed app. Dive into the hero block.

beats.visual: Amber frame, three meshing gears draw and start turning with exact tooth ratios on a shelf
beats.notes: The app runs: parts working together. Dive into the smallest gear.

beats.visual: Checklist ticks; score() fails with an amber X, gets erased and passes; ring fills to 100% and turns amber
beats.notes: Mistakes are caught and fixed — beginners do not need to fear errors.

beats.visual: Serif title traces and fills, amber dot sparks, script subtitle writes itself, a filmstrip of the five previous shots slides in
beats.notes: Hold from 14.0 s; nothing new appears after 14.1 s.

audio.soundDesign: Motion-synced: spark chime, key clicks while typing, whooshes on every cut, ratchet ticks per gear tooth, chimes for passing tests, low buzz + eraser scratch for the failing one, riser into a title impact
audio.music: Procedural Web Audio (code, no samples, no generative AI): 96 BPM ambient pluck/pad, D – Bm – G – A – Em – D, one chord per shot, resolves on D under the title. Rendered offline from a fixed seed and played in sync with the scene clock.
